learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish fixed, variable, direct, indirect and stepped costs
Calculate contribution, break-even and margin of safety
Compute and interpret per-unit economics for a product or customer
Choose a costing approach and understand overhead allocation
Use cost information to support pricing and make-or-buy decisions
Explain the assumptions and limits behind a unit-economics model

integrative_case: A direct-to-consumer brand with a loss-making flagship product must rebuild its unit economics, find break-even and decide whether to reprice, cut cost or discontinue the line.
